summary: Backend 26/26 passing (pytest, 3.7s). Frontend mobile flows verified end-to-end on web preview (390x844): customer login -> home -> product detail (stock badge, in-cart chip, related products, Go to cart secondary, animated toast all work, qty stepper clamps), add to cart -> cart -> checkout -> COD place order -> order-success -> /order/{id} timeline (all 4 status steps rendered: Order placed, Accepted, Out for delivery, Delivered) -> items, address, payment summary all visible. Admin login redirects to /admin/orders, customer to /(tabs)/home — NO redirect loops. Negative: invalid login surfaces 'Invalid credentials' inline; empty cart shows empty state and hides checkout button. ONE spec deviation: order-success 'Track order' button routes to /(tabs)/orders list instead of /order/{id} directly. Deprecated style warnings detected ('shadow*' style props deprecated, use boxShadow; props.pointerEvents deprecated, use style.pointerEvents) — non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: Per the review spec the Track order CTA should navigate directly to /order/{id} (with id returned from POST /api/orders), but it currently calls router.replace('/(tabs)/orders'), so the user has to tap again on the order card to land on the timeline. Reference: /app/frontend/app/order-success.tsx:45. The id param is already available via useLocalSearchParams.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (RN web), should migrate to boxShadow. Multiple components use shadow.soft / shadow.card / shadow.strong via theme.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents (seen on auth & product detail screens).

react_native_issues.issue: Animated toast in product detail logs: 'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' This is benign on web preview but should remain useNativeDriver:true for native — no change needed. Reference: /app/frontend/app/product/[id].tsx:100/107.

action_items: Update /app/frontend/app/order-success.tsx Track order button: change router.replace('/(tabs)/orders') to router.replace({ pathname: '/order/[id]', params: { id } }) so the customer lands directly on the timeline as specified.
Optional polish: replace 'shadow*' style props with boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (or component layer) to remove RN-web deprecation warnings.
Optional polish: replace pointerEvents prop with style={{ pointerEvents: ... }} on Animated.View / Pressable usages.
critical_code_review_comments: Route guards in /(tabs)/_layout.tsx and /admin/_layout.tsx correctly handle loading, unauth, and role mismatch with <Redirect/> — verified no loops in browser.
Order detail screen uses useFocusEffect to refetch on focus — admin status updates will reflect when customer reopens the screen (verified behaviour, not a bug).
Place order disabled state correctly gates on fullName/phone/line1/city/pincode + non-empty cart (checkout.tsx:46-49).

rca_of_issue: Track-order routing miss: order-success.tsx:45 hard-codes router.replace('/(tabs)/orders'). The screen already receives the order id via useLocalSearchParams (line 21) but does not forward it. Fix is a one-line change.
